title: Bananas are BERRIES?! 🍌 #shorts
description:
Gizmo Jr. thinks he can't be surprised… wrong again. 🤖
Fizzo brought three facts that sound fake but are 100% true. ⚡

Which one got you? Comment below! 👇
Follow for a new mind-blowing fact every day!

#facts #funfacts #didyouknow #robot #shorts
facts_checked: Sea otters often hold paws while they sleep floating on the water, so they don't drift apart.
The Eiffel Tower grows a little taller in summer, because its iron expands in the heat (up to about 15 cm).
Botanically, bananas are berries, but strawberries are not.
